channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Podcast's Phony Claims Fuel McFarlane's Continued Campaign Assault on JJ Clemence
item.description: A Hispanic Fort Bend County employee was stunned to learn that a man billed as an expert on Chinese government spies had identified him as a high-ranking Chinese Communist Party official on a local podcast.

item.title: Katy Mills Welcomes New Restaurants, Retailer
item.description: Katy Mills mall has added two new dining concepts and a retail store to its tenant lineup, the mall announced.

item.title: Houston Texans unveil renderings of Bridgeland headquarters, training facilities
item.description: The Houston Texans on Feb. 25 unveiled renderings of their new headquarters and training facilities, advancing plans for a multibillion-dollar mixed-use sports and entertainment district in Bridgeland.

item.title: Westpark Tollway Extension Opens First Segment Saturday in Fulshear
item.description: The first 2-mile segment of the Westpark Tollway Extension opens Feb. 28 in Fulshear, giving drivers a way around the FM 359/FM 1463 intersection.

item.title: Fort Bend County Libraries collecting prom attire donations
item.description: RICHMOND, Texas (Covering Katy News) — Fort Bend County Libraries are collecting gently used prom attire to help teen girls look their best on one of high school's most memorable nights without the burden of cost.

item.title: Remembering a Hero: Body of Fort Bend Deputy Kenneth Lewis Returns Home
item.description: The body of Fort Bend County Sheriff's Deputy Kenneth Lewis will be transported to a Katy funeral home today, Friday, following a procession from Houston, and the Fort Bend County Sheriff's Office is asking drivers to expect delays along the route.

item.title: Katy Man Pleads Guilty in $17 Million Investment Fraud Scheme
item.description: A Katy resident has pleaded guilty to his role in a decade-long scheme that defrauded more than 40 victims out of over $17 million, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office.

item.title: Covering Katy News Endorses JJ Clemence for Fort Bend County Clerk in March 3 Republican Primary
item.description: Covering Katy News endorses JJ Clemence for Fort Bend County Clerk in the March 3 Republican primary, citing her experience, character and the disqualifying conduct of opponent Tamara McFarlane.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Smears and Fear: Disproving the McFarlane Deceptions
item.description: There is a long and ugly tradition in American politics of turning the routine into the sinister. The McFarlane campaign has apparently decided that tradition is worth reviving in Fort Bend County.

item.title: Familiar Face: Clothed by Faith appoints Deysi Crespo as executive director
item.description: Clothed by Faith has appointed Deysi Crespo as its new executive director as the faith-based nonprofit marks serving more than 165,000 individuals since its founding.
